# tests/fixtures/vault — a frozen test fixture

A small Tradecraft vault that the `tradecraft` tests and the CLI transcripts
in `docs/vault/reference/cli-usage.md` run against. It is a fixture, not a
product: its content is frozen to what those tests expect, it is not built or
published anywhere, and it is not kept in sync with any other vault.

Change it only together with the tests that read it.
